description: Live demo (decision 0042, ticket T-54): one laptop, four Docker containers, the real network scheduler moves real Ising tasks between nodes. Demo settings are labelled as such; they are not scored figures.

minimumLoadShare.source: Demo setting: permit pause down to zero for visible control; matches the year explorer comparison scenario in config/reference-house.json.

allowedCpuCoresPerContainer.source: Demo setting: one Docker CPU per visual node, limited by compose.live-demo.yml; not a 1 kW power measurement.

targetTemperatureMinC.source: Demo mapping choice: lower endpoint of the illustrative slider (no heat wanted); not a measured room temperature.

targetTemperatureMaxC.source: Demo mapping choice: upper endpoint (full heat of one server wanted); not a measured room temperature.

stepSeconds.source: Demo choice: one scheduler hour is shown as 4 s so the audience can follow each decision.

serverHoursPerTask.source: Demo calibration: one task is sized to take about one step at one full core (taskSweeps below), so 1 task = 1 server-hour = 1 step at full load.

taskSweeps.source: Measured with 'python3 jobs/research-sim/ising.py calibrate' (TARGET_SECONDS=4) in the development container on 2026-11-21: 18,673. Re-run on the demo laptop inside a node container (README) and set the printed value.

tasksPerJob.source: Demo choice: a job is small enough to finish within its deadline on one warm node.

deadlineSteps.source: Demo choice: 10 scheduler hours from arrival; a node at full heat finishes 6 tasks in 6 steps, a node below 60 % heat cannot.

forecastHorizonSteps.source: Demo choice: horizon of the persistence forecast passed to the scheduler (the LP plans over it; B2 uses only the current hour).

autoSpawnEverySteps.source: Demo choice: when auto-spawn is on, one new job arrives every 3 steps at a node drawn with the seed below.

seed.source: Fixed seed for reproducible auto-spawn and task seeds.
